تختزلوا (form VIII)
# تَخْتَزِلُوا (taḵtazilū) /tax.ta.zi.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَزَلَ (iḵtazala)
# تُخْتَزَلُوا (tuḵtazalū) /tux.ta.za.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَزَلَ (iḵtazala)
